q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT F2.FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT F1.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F2 JOIN FOLLOW F1 ON F2.FOLLOWER = F1.FOLLOWEE GROUP BY F1.FOLLOWEE ORDER BY F1.FOLLOWEE

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because Q1 counts the number of followers for each followee who is also a follower of someone else, while Q2 counts the number of distinct followers for each followee.
counterexample_dsp: The difference is triggered when there are multiple followers for the same followee, and some of these followers are also followers of other users.
